full_content:
# DCL-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-TOOL-PARITY-GATE-001 — Cloud-harness-base adopters must dispatch mutating tools through the base's fail-closed guard adapter

## Constraint

Any cloud harness that instantiates `cloud_harness_base` MUST route every model-requested mutating tool (`Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`) through the base's fail-closed guard adapter (`invoke_guard_adapter`) before mutation, for ALL dialects (`openai-chat`, `anthropic-messages`, `ollama-native`) and ALL hook tiers (`guard-adapter-floor`, `native-full-hooks`). The base enforces this by construction: adopters supply configuration only and cannot substitute raw filesystem writes, raw edits, or raw shell execution for a guarded dispatch. Routing-config `allowed_tools` MUST be a subset of the canonical six (`Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Grep`, `Glob`, `Bash`); non-canonical names are rejected at config-load time.

## Guard coverage (inherited from the base)

- Write: project-root containment, credential-scan, scanner-safe-writer (bridge files), bridge-compliance-gate (bridge files), narrative-artifact-approval-gate, implementation-start-gate — before the file is persisted.
- Edit: project-root containment, credential-scan, bridge-compliance-gate (bridge files), narrative-artifact-approval-gate, implementation-start-gate — before the file is changed.
- Bash: project-root containment, bridge-bash-mutation denial, destructive-gate, formal-artifact-approval-gate, implementation-start-gate — before command execution.

## Fail-closed rule

Any guard deny/ask/checkpoint, parse failure, missing guard file, nonzero adapter error, empty or malformed adapter output, out-of-root path, or unsupported/unrecognized tool schema MUST stop the model tool call. The adapter returns a structured error to the model and MUST NOT partially apply the mutation.

## Native-hook-tier rule

The `native-full-hooks` hook tier does NOT relax the floor. The fail-closed guard adapter remains the enforced mechanism for every hook tier. The concrete native-full-hook lifecycle is wired against a live Anthropic adopter in slice 4 (owner decision `DELIB-20260708-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-SLICE3-NATIVE-HOOK-SCOPE`); until then, and regardless of tier, mutating tools route through the guard-adapter floor.

## Author-metadata rule

For bridge-file and governed-document writes, the adapter MUST set `GTKB_AUTHOR_MODEL`, `GTKB_AUTHOR_MODEL_VERSION`, and the adopter's harness identity metadata (from the `AdopterProfile`) before invoking the guard scripts and before mutation.

## Root-boundary rule

The adapter MUST reject out-of-root paths before invoking the guard scripts and MUST NOT normalize an out-of-root path back into scope.

## Generalization

This design constraint generalizes `DCL-OLLAMA-TOOL-PARITY-GATE-001` from the ollama shim to all `cloud_harness_base` adopters. `DCL-OLLAMA-TOOL-PARITY-GATE-001` remains valid for the not-yet-re-based ollama shim until the Ollama re-base in slice 4; when ollama re-bases onto the base, this constraint covers it.

## Severity

Blocking. Non-canonical exposure widens the attack surface; a shim-side or dialect-side bypass undermines a safety control that is enforced once, in the base, for every adopter and every dialect.

## Anchors

Affected by: `ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001`, `ADR-OLLAMA-HARNESS-ADOPTION-001`. Owner decision anchor: `DELIB-20260708-BUILD-REUSABLE-DIRECT-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE`. Slice-3 native-hook scope: `DELIB-20260708-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-SLICE3-NATIVE-HOOK-SCOPE`.
